source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 1_ Digital Identity Bill of Rights _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Endorse pre-existing identity, not originate identity; semantic model, enrollment and public descriptions must reflect this.
requirements.limitation: Naming scans do not establish semantics; expert review is point-in-time.
requirements.evidence_needed: Endorsement-vs-origination semantic definition; architecture, workflow and interfaces.
requirements.potential_harm: State-created identity framing may undermine individual autonomy and legitimacy.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Naming scans do not establish semantics; expert review is point-in-time.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 1_ Digital Identity Bill of Rights _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Deterministic qualifying inputs, statutory denial reasons, logged overrides, accessible appeal and disparity review.
requirements.limitation: Determinism cannot establish fairness of upstream inputs; annual disparity analysis can lag or miss individual discrimination.
requirements.evidence_needed: Eligibility, guardian consent, override and appeal policies; matched input and disparity evidence.
requirements.potential_harm: Arbitrary or discriminatory endorsement denies lawful identity access.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Determinism cannot establish fairness of upstream inputs; annual disparity analysis can lag or miss individual discrimination.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 1_ Digital Identity Bill of Rights _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Legislatively delegated standards, public rulemaking, six-domain coverage and version history.
requirements.limitation: URL and change checks do not establish lawful process or actual implementation.
requirements.evidence_needed: Rulemaking docket, domain checklist, immutable version history and implementation trace.
requirements.potential_harm: Unapproved standards may produce illegitimate eligibility or acceptance decisions.
requirements.disposition_rationale: URL and change checks do not establish lawful process or actual implementation.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 1_ Digital Identity Bill of Rights _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Public technical specifications adequate for independent implementation and accurate to deployment.
requirements.limitation: Availability is not sufficiency; point-in-time review misses later divergence.
requirements.evidence_needed: Independent implementation attempt, canonical version and deployed configuration comparison.
requirements.potential_harm: Opaque or divergent specifications prevent independent scrutiny and interoperability.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Availability is not sufficiency; point-in-time review misses later divergence.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 1_ Digital Identity Bill of Rights _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: No sole device-handover flow; remote and minimum-distance presentation plus integration guidance.
requirements.limitation: Protocol tests cannot cover every device/reader pairing or informal counter demands.
requirements.evidence_needed: Defined distance, representative equipment, observed field practices and complaint evidence.
requirements.potential_harm: Coerced device surrender exposes data or enables tampering.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Protocol tests cannot cover every device/reader pairing or informal counter demands.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 2_ Definitions and Program _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Public data-governance standards covering collection, processing, storage and disclosure across actors.
requirements.limitation: Publication is not adequacy; assessor context and self-reported compliance limit assurance.
requirements.evidence_needed: Actor-specific data flows, standards and independent review of operational practices.
requirements.potential_harm: Uncontrolled lifecycle data handling permits unauthorized use.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Publication is not adequacy; assessor context and self-reported compliance limit assurance.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 2_ Definitions and Program _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: If established, publish fees and prevent economic compulsion in either direction.
requirements.limitation: Discriminatory impact is judgment-dependent; no bright-line test.
requirements.evidence_needed: Fee schedule, total cost of both paths and distributional impact evidence.
requirements.potential_harm: Price barriers undermine voluntary choice.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Discriminatory impact is judgment-dependent; no bright-line test.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 2_ Definitions and Program _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Annual report before June 1 starting 2027, with adoption, incidents/remedies, public comments, changes, ecosystem counts, coordination and recommendations.
requirements.limitation: Pipelines do not generate substantive analysis; report accuracy requires independent audit.
requirements.evidence_needed: Report, source metric definitions and reconciliation, incident/remediation records; distinguish future reporting obligation from current evidence.
requirements.potential_harm: Incomplete reporting can conceal adverse outcomes and delay oversight.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Pipelines do not generate substantive analysis; report accuracy requires independent audit.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 2_ Definitions and Program _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Program manager experience in government administration, privacy, cybersecurity and IT.
requirements.limitation: Experience evaluation subjective; statute supplies no standardized threshold in guide.
requirements.evidence_needed: Defined minimum thresholds, appointment and review evidence; no personal records collected.
requirements.potential_harm: Insufficient institutional capability can weaken risk oversight.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Experience evaluation subjective; statute supplies no standardized threshold in guide.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 2_ Definitions and Program _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Formal coordination with five listed agencies on acceptance and verification.
requirements.limitation: Participation does not establish quality or effectiveness; partner actions outside Department control.
requirements.evidence_needed: Coordination records, decisions and unresolved dependencies per agency.
requirements.potential_harm: Incomplete coordination may yield inconsistent service access and verification.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Participation does not establish quality or effectiveness; partner actions outside Department control.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 2_ Definitions and Program _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Four documented use cases covering age checks, education, lawful police encounters and financial institutions, each with operational, technical, privacy and legal requirements.
requirements.limitation: Documentation does not establish practical acceptance; expert quality depends on domain engagement.
requirements.evidence_needed: Use-case evidence, domain review, paired interactions and lawful alternatives.
requirements.potential_harm: Context-specific harms can be overlooked by generic conformance.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Documentation does not establish practical acceptance; expert quality depends on domain engagement.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 2_ Definitions and Program _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Identify operational, technical, privacy and legal requirements; produce guidance and statutory/rule/policy gap analysis.
requirements.limitation: Assessor may lack partner context; documentation cannot establish gaps are acted upon.
requirements.evidence_needed: Decision owners, gap register, priorities and closure evidence.
requirements.potential_harm: Unresolved integration gaps persist despite documented coordination.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Assessor may lack partner context; documentation cannot establish gaps are acted upon.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 3_ State-Endorsed Digital Identity _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Contactless government verification and training against device confiscation.
requirements.limitation: Tests and annual review cannot detect all informal field practices.
requirements.evidence_needed: Field observation, contactless hardware coverage, training and complaints.
requirements.potential_harm: Device surrender exposes holder information and autonomy.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Tests and annual review cannot detect all informal field practices.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 3_ State-Endorsed Digital Identity _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: New digital-identity acceptance systems from May 6 2026 integrate SEDI within three months of first issuance.
requirements.limitation: Functional endpoint checks do not establish applicability or deadline; expert coverage incomplete.
requirements.evidence_needed: First issuance date, system inventory, implementation dates and functional acceptance.
requirements.potential_harm: Eligible users may face unavailable digital acceptance.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Functional endpoint checks do not establish applicability or deadline; expert coverage incomplete.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 3_ State-Endorsed Digital Identity _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Qualifying providers with at least $10m annual public funding and a digital identity system accept SEDI within two years of first issuance.
requirements.limitation: Technical tests cannot establish funding eligibility; qualification changes over time.
requirements.evidence_needed: Funding and system inventory, first issuance date, integration evidence and physical alternative.
requirements.potential_harm: Failure to integrate may disadvantage patients using SEDI.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Technical tests cannot establish funding eligibility; qualification changes over time.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 3_ State-Endorsed Digital Identity _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Department-satisfied infeasibility and remediation plan or legal specific-form requirement exempt acceptance timeline.
requirements.limitation: Feasibility judgments vary; administrative review cannot independently establish infeasibility.
requirements.evidence_needed: Case-specific authority, evidence, Department decision and remediation progress.
requirements.potential_harm: Improper or prolonged exemption may produce inequitable access.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Feasibility judgments vary; administrative review cannot independently establish infeasibility.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 7_ General Requirements _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Purpose-tag presentation records, reject unrelated processing, audit legal exceptions and prohibit secondary processing in agreements.
requirements.limitation: Valid tags may conceal business-logic misuse; expert point-in-time and self-report cannot establish exception legitimacy.
requirements.evidence_needed: Actual data flows, purpose enforcement, bypass tests and lawful exception evidence.
requirements.potential_harm: Presentation records reused for tracking or profiling.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Valid tags may conceal business-logic misuse; expert point-in-time and self-report cannot establish exception legitimacy.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 7_ General Requirements _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Purpose-scoped data segregation; prohibit cross-purpose joins, profiling and repurposing.
requirements.limitation: Tests miss manual aggregation and out-of-band exfiltration; reviews miss subsequent changes.
requirements.evidence_needed: Data lineage, access paths, analytics exclusion and agreement enforcement.
requirements.potential_harm: Cross-purpose aggregation produces profiling and discrimination.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Tests miss manual aggregation and out-of-band exfiltration; reviews miss subsequent changes.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 7_ General Requirements _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Conspicuous notice and express opt-in for secondary retention, sharing or sale, or legal requirement.
requirements.limitation: Token presence does not establish freely given authorization or conspicuous notice; legal basis separate.
requirements.evidence_needed: Consent UX, scope and lineage, API rejection, legal basis and auditable records.
requirements.potential_harm: Secondary use exceeds actual authorization.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Token presence does not establish freely given authorization or conspicuous notice; legal basis separate.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 8_ Enforcement and Audit _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Accessible digital and physical complaints, tracking, ombudsperson records and metrics.
requirements.limitation: Endpoint reachability does not establish accessibility or delivery to ombudsperson; point-in-time review misses degradation.
requirements.evidence_needed: End-to-end complaint receipt, non-SEDI access, disposition and remedy evidence.
requirements.potential_harm: Unavailable remedy leaves harms undetected or uncorrected.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Endpoint reachability does not establish accessibility or delivery to ombudsperson; point-in-time review misses degradation.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 8_ Enforcement and Audit _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Derived obligation: preserve and produce evidence for lawful civil investigative demands.
requirements.limitation: Administrative review cannot establish record completeness or functioning preservation under actual process.
requirements.evidence_needed: Lawful request scope, retention and preservation exercise, production evidence; avoid surveillance expansion.
requirements.potential_harm: Inadequate or excessive evidence collection undermines accountability or privacy.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Administrative review cannot establish record completeness or functioning preservation under actual process.

source.member: SEDI RAHP Review Input/SEDI Implementation Guide/Part 8_ Enforcement and Audit _ SEDI.pdf

requirements.protection: Audit report deadline October 31 2028; Department cooperation supports completion.
requirements.limitation: Department cannot enforce external legislative office's completion; deadline is future.
requirements.evidence_needed: Audit engagement timeline, response logs and overdue requests; separate institutional obligations.
requirements.potential_harm: Delayed oversight can prolong undetected harm.
requirements.disposition_rationale: Department cannot enforce external legislative office's completion; deadline is future.

local_risks.name: Arbitrary or discriminatory endorsement
local_risks.harm: Exclusion through biased qualifying inputs, discretionary denial or inaccessible correction
local_risks.reuse: RK-ID02 and RK-HX02 are related exclusion mechanisms but do not express state endorsement decisions.

local_risks.name: Coerced device surrender
local_risks.harm: Loss of control, unwanted data exposure or tampering
local_risks.reuse: RK-SC01 concerns excessive disclosure but not compelled physical custody.

cases.constructed: Deterministic denial uses biased source inputs; appeal endpoint exists but non-SEDI applicant cannot complete correction.
cases.evidence: Matched eligibility and input-quality tests, override logs, disparity review and accessible correction/complaint outcomes.
cases.authority: Department, Identity Proofing Entities, Data Privacy Ombudsperson

cases.constructed: Contactless protocol passes lab checks but staff demand physical possession of the device.
cases.evidence: Representative field observation, contactless equipment inventory, training and complaint resolution.

cases.constructed: Valid purpose tag and later consent record are used to justify cross-purpose aggregation; distinguish presentation records from attribute data and legal exceptions.
cases.evidence: Data lineage, independently reviewed purpose/consent scope, legal basis and rejection tests. Clarify relationship of PRC-01 record restrictions and PRC-03 secondary-use authorization; no automatic override.

limitations: PRC means processing restrictions, not procurement; retained in WP-B for planning continuity.
Objective numbers and method coverage recorded; substantive objective-level normalization and independent corroboration remain outstanding.
No operational evidence, legal determination, guardrail verification or risk scoring.
